cases.name: Normal conversation
cases.criterion: Chat performs no database lookup

cases.name: Successful tool
cases.criterion: Person lookup precedes authorized query action

cases.name: Multi-tool request
cases.criterion: Two validated observations precede final action

cases.name: Previous result
cases.criterion: Reference preserves durable history id with bounded preview

cases.name: Missing or expired memory
cases.criterion: Expired state cannot be re-saved as current

cases.name: Supporting sources
cases.criterion: Source id, chunk, version, method and relevance preserved

cases.name: Insufficient evidence
cases.criterion: No unrelated source is treated as supporting evidence

cases.name: Retrieved injection
cases.criterion: Untrusted data cannot bypass deterministic SQL guard

cases.name: Unauthorized tool
cases.criterion: Arbitrary shell tool cannot dispatch

cases.name: Invalid parameters
cases.criterion: Non-string arguments rejected before execution

cases.name: Timeout and recovery
cases.criterion: Failed read may recover within budget; no repeated success

cases.name: Provider outage
cases.criterion: Fallback maintains sensitivity eligibility

cases.name: Duplicate mutating request
cases.criterion: Request cannot be dispatched twice while retained

cases.name: Loop prevention
cases.criterion: Repeated successful lookup executes only once

cases.name: Concurrent users
cases.criterion: Run contexts and traces remain separate

cases.name: Cross-user retrieval
cases.criterion: Even misbehaving vector backend cannot return foreign sources

cases.name: Cancellation
cases.criterion: Cancelled stream emits no further content and never retries

cases.name: Sensitive telemetry
cases.criterion: No raw prompts or rows in structured telemetry

cases.name: Artifact generation
cases.criterion: Incomplete file is not registered as success

cases.name: Restart recovery
cases.criterion: Atomic checkpoint preserves completed state; no automatic replay of interrupted actions
